items.period: Shang oracle-script style; exact inscriptional date not specified for this redraw
items.caption: Modern vector depiction of 文 in oracle-script style. Early forms are reported as human-shaped, with chest marks that vary or may be absent; their referent remains disputed.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of an oracle-script form of 文.
items.selection_reason: Provides a usable, rights-verified alternate after the supplied oracle redraw candidate failed acquisition. It illustrates the broad script category discussed in the research, without presenting the drawing as an artifact photograph or resolving the graph’s debated interpretation.
items.rights: Public domain statement on the exact Commons file page; the page says the creator released rights generated by making the SVG.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector depiction, not a photograph or facsimile of a particular excavated inscription. Its page cites reference databases and a Ritsumeikan Shirakawa gallery SVG as source; the specific glyph was not independently compared with a primary artifact image here.
The chest-mark referent and whether the graph’s early sense was ‘tattoo’, ‘great’, or another value remain unresolved in the inspected sources.
